a.speaker: Sorrel House, Forest Grove
a.text:
The care home is lit by battery lanterns and the night nurse is alone with thirty-one residents. She won't release anyone without papers. "I'm sorry. I've got people on oxygen and no power. I can't have families just taking whoever they want."

{elder.name} is in the lobby in a coat, with a bag packed.

options.text: Show the power of attorney from Paper Day.
effects: Sorrel House released {elder.name} on the power of attorney.

options.text: "You've got thirty-one people and one pair of hands. One less is one less."
Walk {elder.name} out the side door past the night desk.
Come back in the morning when the day staff arrive.

out.speaker: {elder.name}
out.text: "Took you long enough." {elder.name} hugs you with one arm and grips a cane with the other. "Linemen's card's in my wallet. Thirty-eight years. If they ever restart anything around here, they'll want somebody who remembers how."

out_sneak.speaker: {elder.name}
out_sneak.text: "Like old times," {elder.name} whispers, delighted, and nearly trips on the threshold. Out in the dark: "Linemen's card's in my wallet. Somebody'll want it." Note: {elder.name} walks one tile per AP and slows a bicycle to 25 miles a day.

caught.speaker: Night nurse
caught.text: "No." She is in the hallway with her arms folded. "Come back with the day staff, or with papers." (+5 Strain.)

wait.speaker: Sorrel House
wait.text: You sleep in a lobby chair beside {elder.name}. In the morning the day staff release residents to anyone with a matching surname. You lose the night.

gone.speaker: Sorrel House
gone.text: {elder.name}'s room is empty and the bed is made.
